info.title: noolite
info.description:
Command line interface for the wireless control of appliances using the nooLite system (including nooLite-F mode). Adapter MTRF-64-USB is supported.

            http://www.noo.com.by

commands.name: ports
commands.description: Display the list of the serial ports on this computer.
